headline: MSCI finalizes index rules that could remove Strategy and other crypto treasury firms

scenes.vo: One of the world's biggest index makers just locked in rules that could push Strategy out of its stock indexes. Here's what changed.
MSCI will screen out companies that mostly hold assets instead of running a business. Strategy and Metaplanet were flagged in an earlier test.
Here's why traders are watching it. Current members only get removed after failing the test in two yearly reports in a row, so nothing is automatic.
The catch. If Strategy is dropped, funds that track these indexes would no longer need to hold its stock, and Strategy holds a huge pile of bitcoin.
Here's what happens next. MSCI publishes its final list of affected companies on November eleventh. Changes take effect after the November thirtieth close.
